properties.name: The memory measurement sweeps the task's size against the agent's context, to find where structure starts to matter
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "Go with your recommendation is (b), (c) and (d) next, and (a)" (option a, after b)
properties.statement: The same kind of task is run at several sizes against the answering agent's context (about a tenth, about equal, about ten times), so the size at which reflow2 starts to help shows as the point where the arms' curves cross. It follows the fixed-budget runs, which say how large a difference to look for.
